scientific_depth.justification: Clear novelty framing (decoupled Wide+Deep) with well-defined equations. Missing formal complexity analysis of the Wide MLP vs baseline linear wide.

technical_execution.justification: Complete architecture description with reproducible hyperparameters. Training convergence table strengthens reproducibility. Negative sampling strategy well-motivated.

logical_flow.justification: Sections follow logically from problem motivation through evaluation. Transition from Methodology to Implementation could be smoother. Per-persona analysis is insightful but could connect more explicitly to architectural design choices.

writing_clarity.justification: Generally clear but some dense paragraphs in Related Work. Abstract could be tighter. Some sentence-level redundancy between Introduction contributions list and Conclusion.

evidence_presentation.justification: Three well-formatted booktabs tables with correct numbers. All 4 figures integrated. Coverage-precision trade-off acknowledged transparently. Missing: training convergence table.

academic_style.justification: Formal tone appropriate for IEEE. Some phrases slightly informal (e.g., 'blind spot'). Citation density appropriate. Could benefit from more precise language in qualitative observations.

strengths: Clear architectural novelty: decoupled Wide (Apriori MLP) + Deep (SBERT Two-Tower) with additive scoring
Rigorous full-catalog evaluation protocol (690K predictions) with explicit Krichene & Rendle justification
Comprehensive per-persona cluster analysis revealing differentiated Wide vs Deep branch contributions
Transparent coverage-vs-precision trade-off discussion (HR improves, NDCG slightly decreases)
Production-ready system design with concrete ONNX latency benchmarks
weaknesses: W1: Training convergence data (Table in experimental_log.md) not included in paper — add as table or figure reference
W2: Abstract is slightly long (~150 words); IEEE typically targets 100-150 words. Consider tightening.
W3: The ONNX citation references vaswani2017attention (Transformer paper), not an ONNX-specific paper. Add a footnote clarifying this is the foundational architecture.
W4: Section transitions between Methodology and Implementation lack explicit linkage
W5: Conclusion largely restates results without deeper synthesis of the memorization-generalization balance
questions: Q1: What happens when Apriori rules have zero coverage for a user-item pair? Does Score_Wide default to 0?
Q2: How was the temperature tau=0.1 selected? Was hyperparameter search performed?
Q3: Can the training convergence data from experimental_log.md be included as a table?
